title: [Chattic.us-web] chattic.us Sign in links go to /chat, which returns 403
description:
**Problem**
Every "Sign in" link on the live marketing site https://chattic.us/ points at /chat on the marketing origin. That path returns 403 (S3 AccessDenied). The product lives at https://hey.chattic.us/chat. Board note: Chattic.us-web has no tracked board, so this is filed on Chatticus.

**Evidence**
Live HTML of https://chattic.us/ contains href="/chat" on the Sign in links (checked 2026-10-20). `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://chattic.us/chat` returns 403; `https://hey.chattic.us/chat` returns 200. Source locations in Chattic.us-web: Hero.tsx:69, Header.tsx:40, FinalCta.tsx:26, Footer.tsx:10. The privacy page (page-content.ts:26) also says /chat.

**Fix**
Point all four Sign in links, and the privacy page text, at https://hey.chattic.us/chat (or add a redirect from chattic.us/chat to it).

**How to verify**
`curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://chattic.us/chat` returns 200 or a 301/302 to hey.chattic.us/chat, and clicking Sign in on https://chattic.us/ lands on the product sign-in.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
